rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something whose truth or value has been established, especially before a noun.

example.english: This is a proven method; everyone who has tried it says it works.
example.traditional: 呢個係證實咗嘅辦法，試過嘅人都話掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 zing3 sat6 zo2 ge3 baan6 faat3 si3 gwo3 ge3 jan4 dou1 waa6 dim6

rows.note: Use this specifically when a method, treatment, product, or idea has been shown to work.

example.english: This medicine has proven effective, so there’s no need to switch.
example.traditional: 呢隻藥已經證明有效，唔使再轉喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 ji5 ging1 zing3 ming4 jau5 haau6 m4 sai2 zoi3 zyun2 laa3

rows.note: Use this more formal or written phrasing when stating that a claim or fact has been verified.

example.english: It has been proven that this news report is untrue.
example.traditional: 經證實，呢宗消息並不屬實。
example.jyutping: ging1 zing3 sat6 ne1 zung1 siu1 sik1 bing6 bat1 suk6 sat6
